intent: Welcome: Gator docs explains what the documents are for, with a fuller feature example
notes: The Gator docs Welcome topic now says what Gator docs are for: mapping
systems and flows, discussing proposed features with other architects,
drawing the whole system including its infrastructure, and project views
that executives can read. It credits the charters for the depth of
understanding behind them. The "How does a feature work?" example is now a
full-width commit-gate flow, modelled on the architecture overview
blueprint, and the page notes that a Gator doc is one HTML file that can be
shared as is, for example in Microsoft Teams.
